firstPlayerRule: The player whose Player Mat has the lowest number on its label goes first. Player Mats are dealt randomly during setup.
clarifications: Play proceeds clockwise from the starting player.
Faction Mats and Player Mats are shuffled and one of each is dealt to every player; the Rusviet/Industrial and Crimea/Patriotic combinations are banned and redrawn.
The designer notes that higher-numbered Player Mats have slightly better starting track positions to offset the likely extra turn for the first player.
